assessment: Alpha924: Fixed real unauthenticated simulator-circuit activation. CircuitConnection previously flipped CircuitState::active and triggered read-only Low381 wearables after merely receiving a Low AgentMovementComplete packet ID, including truncated, foreign agent/session or implausible position payloads. New MPL header valid_circuit_movement_complete fully decodes the real LLUDP payload, requires movement request sent, matching current LoginSession AgentID and SessionID, nonzero RegionHandle and finite bounded position BEFORE active state. Valid vertical LookAt remains admitted for legitimate position-only readback. Malformed/foreign reliable packets are ACKed for LLUDP transport but rejected for circuit readiness and initial Low381 request. CircuitStatus counts validated/rejected movement handshake and F3 shows rejected Low15 count without fake avatar/COF/WASD proof. Native C++23 full encode/decode regression tests and Pi5 ARM64 integration plus Python actual handler contract and Mint x64 full CMake/GUI gate. Last verified Pi5 Alpha914 exact feature SHA 55b719e Run 39989404270 success. OpenGenesisLINK upstream main ccfc644d unchanged. Authenticated NexVerse AvatarAppearance/COF/Outfit/Skin GPU and simulator-confirmed WASD/Yaw live E2E still open; no deploy.
